All new features verified working: DuckDuckGo search returns real results, Groups/Pages social features, Personal Reports with image upload, Revenue Dashboard with PDF/CSV export.

DuckDuckGo Search Integration - POST /api/search/collate returns 20+ real results
Image Upload - POST /api/upload/image and GET /api/uploads/{filename} working
Groups Feature - Create, Get, Join, Leave groups all working
Pages Feature - Create, Get, Follow pages all working
PDF Export - GET /api/revenue/export?format=pdf returns valid PDF
CSV Export - GET /api/revenue/export?format=csv returns valid CSV
Personal Reports - Create reports with images (max 3 images enforced)
Groups Page UI - Shows My Groups, Discover Groups, Create Group button
Pages Page UI - Shows My Pages, Discover Pages, Create Page button
Reports Page UI - Shows reports with images, Create Report button
Revenue Page UI - Shows earnings stats, PDF/CSV export buttons
